annotations.title: Dice roller, coin flip, random numbers

description: Roll dice with standard notation (2d6+3, d20, d%, 4d6dl1 / "4d6 drop lowest", 2d20kh1 advantage, 2d20kl1, 5d10dh2; up to 100 dice per term, 2–1000 sides, 20 terms), flip coins (counts + streaks), or draw random whole numbers in a range (optionally unique and sorted, up to 10,000). Crypto random with rejection sampling (no modulo bias); optional seed for reproducible results. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/dice-roller/

flips.description: coin: how many coins to flip.

rolls.description: dice: how many times to roll the expression.

seed.description: Optional seed for a reproducible result (same seed + same input = same output). Omit for true crypto randomness.
